verdicts.note: Checked although verify=false: IMSLP '2 Pieces, Op.10' lists Humoresque (No.2) for violin and piano arr. Kreisler (New York: Charles Foley / Carl Fischer, 1926). Other versions exist (Tchaikovsky's own, Jurgenson 1877; Hartmann, Breitkopf 1916) - keep only the Kreisler entry.

verdicts.title: Danse russe from Swan Lake, Op. 20 (No. 20a)
verdicts.note: The number exists (Act III No. 20a; scored for solo violin and orchestra, IMSLP full score) and is performed separately (e.g. Joshua Bell), but I could NOT find the claimed 'Jurgenson c.1895 violin & piano' edition. Violin-and-piano editions found are modern only: Lauren Keiser/Granat 'Three Solos for Violin and Piano from Swan Lake' (2019) and Galaxy 'Tchaikovsky Violin Album: Solos from the Ballets'. Not a historical arrangement by a notable violinist - low priority; owner may drop it if only established arrangements are wanted.

verdicts.title: Lensky's Aria from Eugene Onegin, Op. 24 (arr. Auer)
verdicts.note: Exists: Leopold Auer's transcription of Lensky's aria (Act II No. 17) for violin and piano, dedicated to Mischa Elman, issued by Universal Edition (UE 7687, Vienna; current reprint); IMSLP lists it under Eugene Onegin as 'For Violin and Piano (Auer)'. I could not confirm the original publisher/date, so the queued 'Carl Fischer c.1920s' is unverified. Title only restyled (no double parentheses, opus added).

gaps.title: Andante funebre e doloroso ma con moto, from String Quartet No. 3 in E-flat minor, Op. 30 (arr. Tchaikovsky)
gaps.edition: Composer's own arrangement, Dec. 1876 for N. von Meck; Jurgenson, Moscow 1877; Henle Urtext HN 961 'Works for Violin and Piano' (ed. Komarov); recorded by S. Rozhdestvensky (Delos DE 3413)
gaps.note: Minutes is an estimate. Rarely played; include only if composer-made arrangements are wanted (IMSLP quartet page also lists it).

gaps.title: Oh! chante encore (arr. Tchaikovsky from the song Op. 16 No. 4)
gaps.edition: Composer's own arrangement of the song Op. 16 No. 4; Henle Urtext HN 961 (ed. Komarov); first recording Delos DE 3413 (2011)
gaps.note: Minutes is an estimate; could not confirm ČW/TH numbers. Obscure - include only if completeness over Henle's volume is wanted.
